images.title: Images
images.intro: Manage IOU/IOL images. Uploaded filenames must follow the naming rules:
images.rejected: Files that don't match are rejected. See the <link>Getting Started guide</link>.
images.empty: No images found. Upload an image to get started.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.hostnameHint: Detected automatically from the backend host.

backend.title: Backend
backend.intro: Configure how the frontend reaches the backend.
backend.internalUrlHint: — used by the Next.js server to reach the backend directly
backend.internalUrlHelp: Typically <mono>http://localhost:8080</mono> when frontend and backend run on the same machine.
backend.publicUrlHint: — used by the browser to reach the backend (console, capture, shell)
backend.publicUrlHelp: Usually left empty: the browser derives the backend address from the page address. Set it only when the backend is behind NAT and its address cannot be derived, e.g. http://203.0.113.10:4000.

shell.title: Shell
shell.intro: SSH into the backend host from the browser.
